title: Family weekend away – Deborah W | Blaco Hill Farm Cottages

post.title: Family weekend away – Deborah W
post.html: Just got back from a gorgeous weekend a blacohill farm. We had 7 cottages between 24 of us and couldn’t of asked for anything better. All the cottages were clean and very well equipped with everything you could think of in the kitchens. The games room was just perfect for us all to meet in after a day out/meal out. Brilliant for both kids and adults. Lovely grasses area which entertained the kids for hours with a football and scooters etc. Fantastic communication from start to finish. Can’t wait to go back
